inputs.name: hand over from Logging and Observability to Production Drift Monitoring

output.level_0: Logs crash and drift alerts never fire, so stale forecasts silently hit the morning order window.
output.level_1: No observability exists, so the team cannot tell if logging feeds drift monitoring or if either is broken.
output.level_2: A human checks raw logs weekly and manually compares them to drift metrics before flagging issues.
output.level_3: Logging streams automatically into drift monitoring, triggering alerts when forecast accuracy deviates from baseline.
output.level_4: Governed pipelines ensure logging and drift monitoring meet audit standards and data retention policies.
